fusions.name: Leeward Pounce
fusions.desc: Rushes you to a target up to 5 tiles away for a raking strike that deals 12 damage, leaves it 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds and [Bleeding] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Toying Swats
fusions.desc: Needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up. Bats 3 claw-cuts of air at it, spread apart, each of which deals 5 damage.

fusions.name: Soft-Footed Passage
fusions.desc: Veils you for 6 seconds: enemies notice you 60% later and you move 22% faster. Attacking ends it.

fusions.name: Stalk, Then Spring
fusions.desc: Every 6 tiles you cover gives your next strike 25% more critical hit chance. Once every 6 seconds.
